subject: Request: safety-net credits while procurement completes
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@medizone.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Rina Kapoor <rina.k@medizone.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot hold — procurement needs a few extra days, can we keep access live?

Hi Lukas,

Quick update from procurement: our legal and vendor onboarding teams flagged a couple of missing fields on the PO and they pushed the approval to their next committee on Aug 26. We were planning to run the pilot next week and I’m worried the team will lose momentum if the sandbox is suspended.

Can Redwood provide a short safety-net so our engineers can keep testing while procurement finishes? A 10–14 day buffer would be ideal. We really like the latency profiles in the demo and want to move forward, but this administrative pause is out of our hands.

I’m attaching a purchase-intent.pdf and my procurement contact Rina is looped in. If you need a formal PO stub or SOW, we can get that to you today.

Appreciate any flexibility,

—Sanjay
Sanjay Patel
Lead Architect, Product Integrations
Medizone Health
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@medizone.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Rina Kapoor <rina.k@medizone.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot hold — procurement needs a few extra days, can we keep access live?

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the heads up and for sending Rina’s contact. Glad the demo looked good.

We can absolutely avoid a hard cutoff while procurement finishes. I’d like to propose a short-term safety-net:
- 14 days of continued sandbox access (no service interruption)
- A capped credit allotment for $1,200 equivalent of token usage (pre-authorized; we’ll monitor)
- We’ll ask for a PO stub or a quick confirmation email from procurement by Aug 26 to keep the window open beyond that.

Camila (cc’d) will set up the credit and track usage. Ben, can you confirm if we need Sales Ops sign-off or Finance to approve this level of credit?

If that works for you, reply with a one-line confirmation (e.g., “Medizone confirms receipt and PO in flight”) and we’ll activate the buffer today.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot hold — procurement needs a few extra days, can we keep access live?

Lukas / Camila — I reviewed the request and approved a short-term credit commit under our SDR pilot policy:
- Action: Grant $1,200 pilot credit (account-specific, non-refundable)
- Duration: 14 calendar days from activation (we’ll note Aug 19 as activation date)
- Conditions: PO stub or confirmation from procurement required for extension; usage cap enforced; auto-disable if suspicious activity detected.

I’ve attached a brief pilot-credit-worksheet.xlsx for tracking and will add a note to DEAL-7831 in HubSpot. Finance has been looped via the worksheet header for audit. Camila — please apply the credit and send confirmation to Sanjay; also paste the DocuSign link if we need a short addendum.

Thanks,
—Ben
Ben Carter
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
(attachment: pilot-credit-worksheet.xlsx)
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@medizone.com>

Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot hold — procurement needs a few extra days, can we keep access live?

Awesome — thanks for the quick turnaround and for being flexible. Medizone confirms receipt and our PO is in flight; procurement expects final signoff Aug 26.

We accept the $1,200 safety-net and will keep usage focused on a short benchmark suite to conserve credits. I’ll upload a PO stub to the shared DocuSign link by EOD tomorrow and Rina will follow up if anything else is needed.

Please mark the HubSpot deal with the extension; I’ll ensure our legal team completes vendor onboarding asap. If we need to convert to a short-term MSA addendum, open the DocuSign and I’ll have it routed.

Thanks again — this keeps our momentum intact.

Best,
Sanjay
